text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's interior minister is to reconsider the organisational structure of the ministry.
- The head of the Palestinian political department said Palestinians were ready to normalise relations with Kuwait.

- Parliament is to come to a decision on Tuesday over disputed house speaker elections. MP Jassem al-Kharafi challenged elections held last month for the post of parliament speaker, alleging they were not constitutional.
- The Kuwait Investment Authority is to organise a seminar on Kuwait's privatisation programme on December 17 in cooperation with the World Bank.
- Kuwait continues to release a large number of detainees from the Talha deportation center as part of a plan to close it.
- The court of appeals halted implementation of a Bad Debts Law on a number of debtors in an urgent ruling on Monday.
- The United Nations plans to take the remains of Iraqi Scuds for study.
